sections.eyebrow: Where family adventure and conservation run wild
sections.title: A dream *fifteen years in the making*

image.alt: The safari park entrance, lined with palms

body: Eudora Wildlife Safari Park was founded by Mark Nisbet and is the first drive-thru safari park in South Carolina. Mark has more than 30 years of experience caring for exotic animals, and spent 15 years building the park around education, preservation and conservation.

The park opened in a whirlwind for Mother’s Day 2020, rushing the giraffe exhibit to be ready. Today the walk-thru trail keeps growing, bringing families face to face with animals from around the world.
list: Education and conservation at the heart

sections.eyebrow: Safety first, for you and the animals
sections.title: On *the safari loop*

columns.title: In your vehicle
items: Stay inside; doors closed, windows open
Drive 5 mph; honk if you need a ranger
No riding in truck beds; Jeeps keep doors and top on

columns.title: Feeding
items: Only the park’s feed, never your own food
Feed from the bucket, not from your hand
Never roll up a window while an animal is feeding

columns.title: Good to bring
items: A driver’s license: drivers must be 18 or older
Cash or a card: we take both
Pets stay in the car or on a leash in the lot

items.q: Do I need to buy tickets in advance?
items.a: Not for the drive-thru: general admission is sold at the gate. Wagon rides must be booked online in advance.
The last car enters the gates at 4 pm. We’re open 10 to 6 Monday to Saturday, and noon to 6 on Sunday.
